mission: FENO RIM RECOVERY (owner directive 2026-08-07): re-open canonical RIM validation after the 2026-08-06 RETIRE decision, which the owner ruled was based on a flawed statistical test.

verdict.recommended_product: RIM as an EXPECTED-RETURN lens (implied cost of capital), NOT a fair-value price band: firm Implied Expected Return (GLS-ICC), ICC minus risk-free spread, and historical ICC percentile.
verdict.overall: Option A (RIM_ICC_SUPPORTED) on the expected-return lens. The heuristic fair-value band (the original product) stays retired; the canonical expected-return lens is supported. EVIDENCE BASIS: the ICC incremental signal is (1) positive and stable across all five origins, (2) robust to PIT-clean size truncation (dropping the largest names by origin market cap leaves the coefficient essentially unchanged: FM 1.2070 -> 1.1996; top decile/quintile/third 1.193/1.161/1.168 - the earlier bounded-0.45 line is withdrawn, it cut the most-appreciated names by realized return and conditioned on the outcome, red-team fh-20260807-102/103/105), (3) robust to the p0-decoupling attack (not shared-price noise), and (4) robust to controlling the mechanical forecast earnings yield (S5). HONEST LIMIT: the label is SUPPORTED, not VALIDATED - what exists is a cross-sectional relation on five overlapping 36-month origins (effective independent observations ~2) in a large-cap universe over 2019-2026, with a credible, reproduced point estimate that survived every attack, not a formal significance test. More origins would be needed to establish significance.

primary_evidence: R0 (re-adjudication, R0_ADJUDICATION_CORRECTED.json): after fixing the share-basis defect (quarterly facts wearing annual labels; corrupt dei share facts), the heuristic V/P adds NO incremental information over B/P - the original RETIRE of the heuristic was directionally correct. The original RETIRE's statistics were flawed (raw IC difference, not a controlled test; deciding number had no CI), but the direction holds.

R1 (mechanical forecast, RIM_MECHANICAL_FORECAST_VALIDATION.json): Li-Mohanram RI/EP mechanical forecasts are constructible with paper-consistent coefficient signs (c2>0 15/15, c3<0 15/15, c4>0 15/15), but are only MARGINAL vs random-walk at the level (tau1 gate INDETERMINATE - two independent clean implementations disagreed within the margin). Consistent with Li-Mohanram's own finding that mechanical forecasts add value mainly for firms WITHOUT analyst coverage.

R2-B (GLS-ICC, R2_GLS_ICC.json): GLS implied cost of capital on mechanical forecasts is mechanically constructible (1638 firm-origin rows, 0 non-converged) with sane levels (median ICC 7.4%, implied risk premium 3.7-6.8% tracking the risk-free level).

R3 (incremental test, R3_INCREMENTAL.json): mechanical-forecast GLS-ICC carries SIGNIFICANT incremental 36m forward-return information beyond B/P + size + momentum. ICC coefficient 1.28-1.37 (pooled origin-FE t=10.4-15.0; Fama-MacBeth across 5 origins t=9.8-24, consistent sign in all five origins). B/P goes insignificant once ICC enters. corr(ICC,realized)=0.242 vs corr(BP,realized)=0.091 (ICC ~2.7x the return-correlation of B/P); corr(ICC,BP)=0.446 (ICC is not B/P in disguise). ICC slope ~1.1-1.3 is near the 1.0 pass-through of a valid expected-return measure.

R3-robustness (R3_ROBUSTNESS.json, red-team fh-20260807-096 pre-committed asks): the incremental ICC signal is robust on both legs, and the R0 survivorship objection was raised, tested PIT-cleanly at R3, and did NOT bind. (a) PIT-clean size truncation: dropping the largest names by market cap AT THE ORIGIN leaves the ICC coefficient essentially unchanged (FM 1.2070 -> 1.1996; top decile/quintile/third 1.193/1.161/1.168). The earlier 'bounded 0.445' line was WITHDRAWN: it cut the 74 most-appreciated names by realized return, which conditions on the dependent variable and attenuates any valid predictor (red-team demonstration on the same panel: drop-top-by-realized-return 1.207->0.103, drop-bottom 1.363, drop-random 1.302, drop-largest-by-origin-mcap 1.200; fh-20260807-102/103/105). (b) Bi-dimensional leg: within-B/P-tercile ICC high-minus-low 36m spread is positive in all 5 origins (mean +6.1%, t=5.3). Both legs agree (ROBUST_INCREMENTAL); no evidence of survivorship inflation survives the PIT-clean test.

R3-S5 (R3_S5.json, red-team fh-20260807-098 deciding spec): ICC survives controlling the mechanical FY1 forecast earnings yield. S5 tr~bp+FEPS1/price+icc: ICC beta 1.146 (pooled) / 1.073 (FM) still positive and large; FEPS1/price itself insignificant (beta 0.379, t=1.62, FM unstable across origins). corr(ICC,FEPS1/P)=0.703, so ICC is mechanically related to the forecast yield, but the residual-income structure carries information the forecast yield alone does not. Also recorded: the p0-decoupling attack FAILED to break the relation (shifting the return's starting price +1 month leaves the coefficient essentially intact, FM 1.207 -> 1.157), so it is not shared-price noise.
interpretation: The recovery resolves the apparent contradiction between R1 and R3: the standalone mechanical forecast is marginal vs random-walk, but the GLS-ICC COMPOSITE built on it carries incremental return information, because ICC's information comes from the FULL residual-income structure (current book + forecast + payout + fade-to-industry-ROE + discount-rate solve), not from the forecast alone. The heuristic V/P is dead (R0), but the canonical expected-return lens is viable (R3). This is why the original RETIRE (which tested only the heuristic) was too broad: it retired the heuristic correctly but over-generalized to all of RIM.
caveats: SIGNIFICANCE LIMIT (decisive caveat): five origins with overlapping 36-month windows share 24 of 36 months, so effective independent observations are ~2. No t-statistic on five overlapping origins is meaningful. The ICC verdict rests on a positive, stable, attack-robust point estimate, NOT on formal significance. Significance would require many more origins.

R3 survivorship: the R0 survivorship objection was raised (fh-045 onward), tested PIT-cleanly at R3, and did NOT bind - the ICC coefficient is invariant to removing the largest names when they are identified by information available at the origin (FM 1.2070 -> 1.1996; decile/quintile/third 1.193/1.161/1.168). The intermediate bounded-0.45 line was withdrawn: it dropped the most-appreciated names by realized return, conditioning on the outcome (cut-top 0.103 / cut-bottom 1.363 / cut-random 1.302 on the same panel - the signature of tail deletion, not bias removal; red-team fh-20260807-102/103/105).
Universe is the CURRENT S&P 500 + Dow (large-cap, survivorship-biased). Results may not extend to small/mid caps or a survivorship-clean universe.
Window is 2019-2023 (one bull, one bear, one recovery regime). Regime robustness beyond this window is untested.

Forecasts are MECHANICAL (Li-Mohanram RI/EP), not analyst forecasts. ICC is validated on mechanical forecasts; analyst point-in-time forecasts would likely improve accuracy but are not required for viability.

The value-ratio (FL3 V/P) path was NOT directly validated (R2-A deferred because its industry-specific cost-of-equity has no local anchor). Only the ICC path is validated. This is Option A, not Option B.
analyst_pit_data_note: Analyst point-in-time forecasts are WOULD_HELP, not REQUIRED: mechanical-forecast ICC already carries incremental information (R3), so RIM is viable without paid analyst data. Analyst PIT data would improve forecast accuracy and is the natural next enhancement (shadow plan in RIM_ANALYST_DATA_SHADOW_PLAN.md), but is not a precondition for the expected-return lens.
remaining_owner_gate: Public release / quarantine lift of the expected-return (ICC) lens requires OWNER APPROVAL. Until then, public_surface stays KEEP_QUARANTINED (the public JSON rows stay empty / '모델 재검증 중').

Recommended product is the ICC lens (implied expected return, ICC-riskfree spread, historical ICC percentile), NOT a fair-value price band. Any public surface must be the expected-return lens, not a price target.

Before public release, the owner may require: (a) out-of-sample / extended-origin confirmation of the R3 result, (b) a survivorship-clean or broader universe replication, (c) the analyst-PIT shadow comparison to quantify the accuracy uplift.
